core_requirements: A class that is defined inside another class

content.question_text: What is an anonymous inner class?

core_requirements: An inner class without a name — only the implementation is given

content.question_text: What is the typical use case for an anonymous inner class?

core_requirements: When you want to create only a single object of that class, one-off, without needing a reusable named class

content.question_text: Write the general syntax pattern for defining an anonymous inner class.

core_requirements: new SuperType(constructionArguments) { inner class methods and data }

content.question_text: Can an anonymous inner class have a constructor? Why or why not?

core_requirements: A constructor's name must match the class name, and an anonymous inner class has no name

content.question_text: If anonymous inner classes can't have their own constructor, what are the construction arguments in 'new SuperType(constructionArguments) {...}' actually used for?

core_requirements: They are passed into the superclass's constructor

content.question_text: When the supertype of an anonymous inner class is an interface, do you supply construction arguments in the parentheses? Why or why not?

core_requirements: No arguments are supplied because interfaces have no constructor
The empty parentheses () are still required syntactically

content.question_text: What happens when an anonymous inner class's supertype is a class rather than an interface?

core_requirements: The anonymous inner class extends that superclass
